data.one_liner: Dart encryption library for files, plain text and binary data using AES Crypt format.
data.what_it_does: Provides 256-bit AES encryption and decryption for files, text, and binary data in pure Dart. Fully compatible with the AES Crypt file specification version 2 across all platforms including the web. It also supports SHA256 and HMAC-SHA256 computations.
use_when: You need to encrypt or decrypt files compatible with the AES Crypt standard format.
You want to secure plain text strings or binary data inside a Dart or Flutter app using 256-bit AES.
You require pure Dart cryptographic operations that work across all platforms including web.
avoid_when: You are looking for hardware-backed secure storage or OS keychain wrappers instead of file/data encryption.
You need high-level database encryption rather than general file/stream encryption.
strengths: Compatible with standard AES Crypt file formats used by other software across operating systems.
Supports Unicode passwords, custom overwrite modes, and both synchronous and asynchronous operations.
Implemented in pure Dart making it work on all platforms including web.
weaknesses: Backwards compatibility with version 1 of the AES Crypt specification is untested.
Limited built-in cipher modes for custom low-level encryption compared to heavier crypto libraries.
